topic: Using the Work of an Internal Auditor
question: How should an external auditor decide whether the work of the internal audit function can be used under SA 610, and what are the limits on using it?
sources: SA 610 Using the Work of Internal Auditors

points.label: Sole responsibility of the external auditor
points.description: The external auditor has sole responsibility for the opinion expressed, which is not reduced by using the work of internal auditors.
points.basis: SA 610, external auditor's sole responsibility for the audit opinion

points.label: Evaluating the internal audit function
points.description: Evaluate the extent to which the organisational status and relevant policies support the objectivity of the internal auditors, their level of competence, and whether the function applies a systematic and disciplined approach including quality control.
points.basis: SA 610, evaluating the internal audit function (objectivity, competence and systematic approach)

points.label: Determining whether and to what extent to use the work
points.description: Consider the nature and scope of the work performed, and its relevance to the audit strategy and plan; the higher the risk and the more judgment involved, the less the work should be relied on.
points.basis: SA 610, determining the nature and extent of work of the internal audit function that can be used

points.label: Evaluating and testing the work used
points.description: Evaluate whether the work was properly planned, performed, supervised, reviewed and documented and the evidence is appropriate; re-perform some of the work to test its adequacy.
points.basis: SA 610, using the work of the internal audit function and performing procedures on it

points.label: Communication and when work cannot be used
points.description: If the criteria are not met, do not use the work; discuss with those charged with governance and document the conclusions on the work used and the procedures performed.
points.basis: SA 610, circumstances where the work cannot be used, communication with those charged with governance, and documentation
